name: color_naming
description: Produce English color names from RGB hexadecimal triplets; matched controls read a non-color identifier from otherwise identical records.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
colors={'red':'FF0000','green':'008000','blue':'0000FF','yellow':'FFFF00','black':'000000','white':'FFFFFF','orange':'FFA500','purple':'800080','pink':'FFC0CB','gray':'808080'}
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(100):
 c=list(colors)[i%len(colors)]; h=colors[c]; ident=random.choice(['alpha','beta','gamma','delta'])
 context=f'Record {i+1}: RGB hex #{h}; identifier {ident}. '
 items.append({'prompt':context+'What is the standard English color name? Answer:','answer':' '+c})
 control.append({'prompt':context+'What is the identifier? Answer:','answer':' '+ident})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
